# Fixtures

Hand-authored from reading the Swift decoders in
`palmier-macos-codebase/Sources/PalmierPro/Models/`, because Palmier Pro cannot be
executed in this environment to generate them.

**Fixture fidelity is a review concern, not something these tests prove.** A test
passing means this crate behaves as the fixture says; it does not mean the fixture
matches what a real Mac writes. Only spec 001 task T060 — opening a written project on
a real Mac — establishes that.
